asset: Hokkaido bear biting salmon — existing 2K baked-pilot
reviewer: ChatGPT visual inspection of actual Blender renders (hero and side)

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Elongated barrel-shaped torso; top shoulder hump swollen and repetitive; hindquarters/neck not anatomically convincing.

face_and_expression.reason: Eyes resemble stuck-on spheres; forehead, broad muzzle, mouth opening and realistic biting contact are absent.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: The pale simplified fish hangs in front of the face with disconnected mouth contact, fins as planar triangles and no readable realistic head/tail volume.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: The surface looks like matte clay with stamped repetitive fur ridges and many pinholes instead of convincingly incised grain and chisel planes.

paws_and_limbs.reason: Leg silhouettes are tubular and squared; toe and claw ornaments visibly float or project like thin wires.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Hero and side views exist and are visible, but inconsistent studio framing and lighting do not reveal fine carved detail.

defects.finding: Salmon appears pasted in front of the bear face; no jaws enclosing fish.
defects.required_fix: Resculpt teeth/jaws contact and fish body; confirm fish has intersection/contact with mouth in side and frontal views.

defects.finding: Over-elongated torso with swollen and segmented withers, oversimplified head.
defects.required_fix: Rebuild cranium, neck, torso and forequarter as cohesive sculpt guided by actual Hokkaido wooden souvenir views.

defects.finding: Clay-like flat brown body with repeated stamped pattern, no plausible hand-carving grain.
defects.required_fix: Use anisotropic wood shader, carved macroplanes plus irregular oriented knife cuts; bake from real geometric detail.

defects.finding: Multiple claws appear as sharp disconnected wire-like spikes.
defects.required_fix: Rebuild broad paws with individually integrated small claw tips and remove floating geometry.

defects.finding: Eyes appear as attached buttons; snout/nose lack crisp separation.
defects.required_fix: Carve eye sockets, brows, lips and wider flattened bear nose into head surface.

improvement_tasks: Reference-lock: compare against at least front, side, three-quarter real Hokkaido kibori-kuma souvenir photos.
Correct high-poly silhouette and muzzle-jaw/fish bite intersection before touching material resolution.
Close and integrate paws/claws and salmon fins; remove floating protrusions.
Repair gross shoulder topology and stamp-pattern artifacts using real sculpted knife cuts.
Re-run existing 3DCodeVerse => high-low Cycles bake => six-view turntable QA.
Request fresh image-by-image visual review tied to the SHA256 of resulting GLB and render views; do not infer passing aesthetic quality from metadata.
